about: Test cases for the action binding extension 0.2.0. Schema cases apply a patch to a base attachment (A0: an approved and executed payment; A1: a rejected one) or to base_report (an empty patch tests the base itself), so each negative case differs from a valid instance by the one thing it tests; C cases check the fixture records against the core decision-record schema in standard/v5.0. Binding cases run the reference check on one attachment, with its decision record or without it (record null); every dimension is expected verified, and execution_state attempted, unless the case's expected says otherwise. Pairing cases read base_report with the attachments it covers (report_covers, or the case's covers), holding the records in report_records, which JSON Schema cannot do. An attachment's bytes as received are, in these cases, its JSON text with no whitespace and members in the order given, in UTF-8; attachment_digest is their SHA-256, and a pairing case that changes an attachment also gives its new digest, except where the case tests that. Patch operations: set, remove, copy (to), insert (into a list), move (to). Specifications S0 to S5 and records R0 to R2 are synthetic; their bytes are the UTF-8 (here ASCII) encoding of each text, and the digests below also serve as simple vectors. S1, S2 and S3 change only the amount, the target and the destination of S0; S5 is S0 without its policy_version. R0 is affirmed and sealed: its seal_hash is the SHA-256 of R0 with the seal_hash value replaced by 64 zeros, as the repository's governance records are sealed. R2 is R1 with a review_log outcome word the check does not know. R3 is R0 with two reviewers in its review_log, and R4 is R0 with an affirmation time that has no offset; both are sealed the same way.
